text:
maria: quick question — should saving a per-route view auto-pin the currently selected model and filters as a single 'save bundle'?
aj: i lean no for auto-pin by default. surprise pinning is confusing and can increase token burn if route is high-traffic.
leo: agreed with aj. we can show a toggle in the save modal: "pin model and filters" default off. :+1:
samir: telemetry concern — if we pin model versions in saves, we need to emit labels to differentiate "save.bundle.pin=true" and record model_id/model_version for rollback evals.
nisha: platform concerns: pinned models affect routing policies and quota accounting. if we pin to a heavy model we should surface expected cost estimate in the save preview.
maria: good points. UX ask: make it easy for product folks to create a stable view they can hand to integrations without surprising cost changes.
leo: prototype idea — save modal shows: "Bundle type: ephemeral (track route + filters) / fixed (include model + quantization)". default ephemeral.
aj: for API contract, suggest endpoint POST /saved_views with body: {"route_id":..., "filters":..., "bundle_type":"ephemeral|fixed", "pin_model": {"model_id":"x", "version":"v1"} }
leo: sample payload we sketched:
```
{
  "route_id": "route:checkout",
  "filters": {"status":"failed"},
  "bundle_type": "fixed",
  "pin_model": {"model_id":"redwood-open-1", "version":"2026-02-10"}
}
```
aj: if bundle_type=fixed then backend should store model metadata and surface it in the console and telemetry. Also enforce quota checks at save time and warn.
samir: telemetry events we need: saved_view.create (bundle_type, model_id?, estimate_tokens, creator_id) and saved_view.apply (who used it, resolved_model_id)
deploy-bot: deployment note: rolling change to saved view model resolution must be backwards compatible — old saves without model metadata should resolve to route default.
maria: decision proposal: do not auto-pin. Add explicit "Include model in save" toggle (off default). API: support bundle_type. Backend: warn on cost and record telemetry labels. Rollout: gradual opt-in for power users, then default UI exposure after 1 month.
leo: i'll mock the save modal and wire the toggle.
aj: i'll add server checks + quota warning endpoint.
samir: i'll add telemetry spec stubs.
nisha: i'll work on cost estimate hooks with infra.
maria: thanks everyone — ping me when mocks are ready. :rocket:
